items.title: Wall Street Has No Idea What Anthropic Is Worth
items.summary: Anthropic sets its IPO range and Wall Street promptly argues about whether it's too high, too low, or a referendum on the whole AI trade, while a new Claude productivity suite knocks Microsoft's stock. Meanwhile Google's Gemini 4 Carbon finally ships, Nvidia's spy scandal deepens, and OpenAI posts a record quarter. The honest takeaway from all the IPO numbers: nobody actually knows yet.
